backbuffer.captured_canvas: battle background layer -1 before canvas 0 world

entry.mask_transparent: write source RGBA with blending disabled
entry.can_run_explanation: Queued DialogueBox cutscene battles pass can_run=false

menu.confirm_boundary: emit selected request only; action execution outside this entry slice
